The '''apartments''' of [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Haydnat Treen]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] were serviced by her [[Treen family|family's]] [[BII Butler Droid]] [[Wyx]]. It included a banister by the door and an office upstairs that featured [[Painting/Legends|paintings]] and statues from the best artists of her [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], the planet [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]]. The office also had a black [[Nerf-hide/Legends|nerf-hide]] chair, a [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojector]], and automatic lighting. Treen relaxed in her apartments by taking a [[Temperature/Legends|hot]] and scented [[Bath/Legends|bath]].
